lines.zh: 我摆着骨头做的鳍往前游
lines.en: I swim on with fins made of bone.

lines.zh: 水从我的骨架缝里穿过去
lines.en: Water passes through the gaps in my frame.

lines.zh: 我贴着一具沉船的龙骨游
lines.en: I swim along a sunken ship's keel.
I swim crooked; the bones are light.

lines.zh: 一群同类在我后面跟着
lines.en: A school follows behind me.
I roll over in the shallows.

lines.zh: 我的尾骨拍出一串小泡
lines.en: My tail bones beat out a string of bubbles.
I smell carrion.
I swim a loop around the weeds.

lines.zh: 我们的骨头撞在一起，像风铃
lines.en: Our bones strike together like wind chimes.
I sink a little deeper.
I swim over a heap of fish bones.
My ribs open and close in the water.
I travel the stone seams along the shore.
I pause to taste the water.

lines.zh: 同类的骨架把我挤向一边
lines.en: My kin's frames nudge me aside.

lines.zh: 我从一群里游到另一群
lines.en: I drift from one school to another.
The water clouds where I pass.

lines.zh: 我悬在水里，骨头轻轻晃
lines.en: I hang in the water, bones swaying.
The school hangs around me, still.
I open and close my jaw.
The silt settles slowly.
I am waiting for whoever dies first.

lines.zh: 我没有眼睛，可我知道方向
lines.en: I have no eyes, yet I know the way.
Weeds brush my ribs.
Bubbles rise off my back.
I coil my tail around a stone.

lines.zh: 我听见远处有东西沉下来
lines.en: I hear something sink far off.
I rest my jaw on a stone.
The school turns above me.

lines.zh: 我把骨头抖了抖，泥落下去
lines.en: I shake my bones and the mud falls.
I sway gently with the current.
I turn toward where you are.

lines.zh: 我没有眼睛，但闻得到你
lines.en: I have no eyes, but I smell you.
You stand on the shore, too high.

lines.zh: 我浮上来一点，靠近水面
lines.en: I rise a little toward the surface.
You smell of the living.
My jaw works under the water.
I spread my fins for you to see.

lines.zh: 你的影子落进水里，我追它
lines.en: Your shadow falls in the water; I chase it.
Step back; I cannot come ashore.
My fin points at you, then drops.
One of my bones has snapped.
I come apart, then gather again.
My bone chips cloud the water.
I sink a little.
My fins will not obey.
I roll half over before I steady.
My tail bone breaks off in the water.
I sink to the mud, then rise.
One vertebra has gone crooked.
The water is full of my bone chips.

lines.zh: 那味道是从你手里来的
lines.en: That smell comes from your hand.
Is it food? Throw it down.

lines.zh: 我不挑，骨头里也吃得出味
lines.en: I am not fussy; bones can taste.

lines.zh: 水花溅起来，我扑了一下
lines.en: I splash up once at it.
I wait with my jaw open.

lines.zh: 同类的骨头挤在我背后
lines.en: My kin crowd behind me.

lines.zh: 这一口抢不到，我就等下一口
lines.en: If I miss this bite, I will wait for the next.

lines.zh: 我扑了一下，水花打在岸上
lines.en: I lunge and spray hits the shore.

lines.zh: 同类的头骨挤到我旁边
lines.en: A kin's skull crowds in beside mine.
I open my jaw as wide as it goes.
You step into the water and hit me.

lines.zh: 我的骨头在你腿上刮过
lines.en: My bones scrape your leg.
A flick of my tail knocks my kin aside.
The water churns to white foam.

lines.zh: 我的肋骨卡在你的鞋上
lines.en: My ribs catch on your shoe.

lines.zh: 我退开一尺，骨头散了一下
lines.en: I retreat a foot and my bones loosen.

lines.zh: 你踩进水里，一群都涌上来
lines.en: You step in the water and the school surges.

lines.zh: 我撞在你的膝上，弹开了
lines.en: I hit your knee and bounce off.

lines.zh: 水面被我撞开一圈波纹
lines.en: My impact opens a ring of ripples.
My kin knock into me from behind.

lines.zh: 我的头骨磕到你的鞋底
lines.en: My skull knocks your sole.
I roll over and back again.
Two skeletons swim side by side.

lines.zh: 我们的骨头互相碰，很轻
lines.en: Our bones touch, very lightly.
There is no other sound in the water.
We twist our tail bones together.
She swims steadier than I do.
We sink together.
Seaweed hangs on her bones.
We lie side by side on the bottom.
The current nudges us together.

lines.zh: 她的尾骨搭在我的背上
lines.en: Her tail bone rests on my back.

lines.zh: 我咬住一块沉下来的东西
lines.en: I bite what sank down.
A jaw of bone holds tight.

lines.zh: 我把它吞进去，卡在肋骨间
lines.en: I swallow it and it lodges between my ribs.
I pick up a scale.

lines.zh: 我把一块石头推到旁边
lines.en: I push a stone aside.
I take up a fish bone.

lines.zh: 我从泥里叼出个硬东西
lines.en: I pull something hard from the mud.
I carry it on my head as I swim.
I hide it in a stone crack.
I bite it apart and taste.
I turn to you, fins spread.
I smell your blood.
The water begins to flow toward me.
I speed up along the bottom.
I press low against the mud.
All my fins spread wide.

lines.zh: 骨缝里，我听见你的心跳。
lines.en: Through my bone seams, I hear your heart.

lines.zh: 我绕到你站的那块石头下
lines.en: I come under the stone you stand on.
I churn the bottom silt up.
I raise my head toward your feet.
I circle you, rising and falling.
You stand in the shallows; you cannot run.

lines.zh: 我的骨头在你腿边擦过
lines.en: My bones brush past your legs.

lines.zh: 我不急，水里我有的是时间
lines.en: I am in no hurry; water gives me time.

lines.zh: 你走到深一点的地方了
lines.en: You have stepped into deeper water.
I circle at your feet.
The school's frames close in.
My dorsal fin cuts the surface.

lines.zh: 你每动一下，水就告诉我
lines.en: Every move you make, the water tells me.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的小腿擦过去
lines.en: I slide past your calf.
I ram your shin with my skull.
We roll over bone piles in shoals.

lines.zh: 我的尾骨抽在你脚踝上
lines.en: My tail bone snaps at your ankle.
Water flies up; I fall back.
I snap at your ankle.
My whole frame slams into you.
I butt your knee from below.
My teeth are not sharp, but hard.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的裤脚往下拖
lines.en: I bite your hem and drag down.
I roll into your legs.
I swim out of the bone heap.
A layer of silt lifts from the bottom.
My frame assembles itself.
A school trails behind me.
A few bubbles break the surface.

lines.zh: 我在水里立着，像根柱子
lines.en: I stand in the water like a post.

lines.zh: 我的骨头一根根浮起来
lines.en: My bones float up one by one.
The water at the shore shallows.
I stop among the weeds.

lines.zh: 一群同类从四面聚过来
lines.en: The school gathers from all sides.

lines.zh: 火在水上烧，水变热，我难受
lines.en: Fire burns on the water, it warms, and I suffer.
I fall from the surface back to the bottom.

lines.zh: 我在水里活着，可这水里没有气
lines.en: I live in water, yet this water holds no air.

lines.zh: 爆炸把水和骨头一起掀开
lines.en: The blast throws water and bone apart.
An arrow passes through my frame.

lines.zh: 那股力量把我们的骨头全拨散了
lines.en: That force scatters all our bones.

lines.zh: 很久没有东西沉下来了
lines.en: Nothing has sunk down for a long while.

lines.zh: 雷打进水里，我的骨头都在抖
lines.en: Lightning enters the water and all my bones shake.

lines.zh: 水没有了，我的鳍在空中划
lines.en: No water left; my fins paddle air.
